question: Which of the following is a cartilaginous fish?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shark.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Cartilaginous fishes ragarded the **oldest surviving jawed vertebrates** and, as the name suggests, have a skeleton made out of cartilage.
 
• They include **sharks, rays, and skates (elasmobranchii) and chimeras (holocephali)**.
 
• Sharks are a **special type of fish** because** their bodies are made out of cartilage** instead of bones like other fish.
 
• The classification of this kind of fish is "**elasmobranch**."
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6bf08baf4d224fd78b168486bd9e686087277028bc47f56622eedb80f4a6fda.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The rohu is a **large, silver-colored fish of typical cyprinid shape, with a conspicuously arched head**.
 
• **Tuna is and be one of the most eaten fish in the world**. 
 
• **Salmon **is the common name for many species of ray-finned fish in the family **Salmonidae.**​
